name: std-calendar
description: std-calendar as a Function — owns the fetch + SELECT_DAY state machine; default bodyContent renders the month-grid + upcoming-events tree. `config.calendarLook` switches the body between the default month-grid ('month'), a day-grouped agenda list ('agenda-list'), and a 7-column week timeline ('week-timeline') while inheriting the same trait, state machine, emits, and listens.

schema.name: std-calendar
schema.description: std-calendar as a Function — owns the fetch + SELECT_DAY state machine; default bodyContent renders the month-grid + upcoming-events tree. `config.calendarLook` switches the body between the default month-grid ('month'), a day-grouped agenda list ('agenda-list'), and a 7-column week timeline ('week-timeline') while inheriting the same trait, state machine, emits, and listens.

fields.name: name
fields.description: event title shown on the calendar

fields.name: time
fields.synonyms: start, scheduled time, begins, when, start time

emits.description: Indicates that calendar events have been successfully retrieved.
Indicates a failure to load calendar events.

Emitted when a calendar chip is clicked ({ event } carries the clicked row) or an agenda/upcoming row action fires ({ id, row }). Consumers routing it should read the row from ?event or ?row, whichever the payload carries.

events.name: CalendarEvent loaded
events.description: Indicates that calendar events have been successfully retrieved.

events.name: CalendarEvent load failed
events.description: Indicates a failure to load calendar events.

events.name: Select Day
events.description: A day has been chosen within the calendar view.

events.name: Calendar Prev Week
events.description: Move the week timeline one week earlier.
events.synonyms: previous week, back a week, earlier week, last week

events.name: Calendar Next Week
events.description: Move the week timeline one week later.
events.synonyms: next week, forward a week, later week, following week

events.name: Refetch Query
events.description: Triggers a data refresh based on the current query.

events.name: Refetch Filter
events.description: Triggers a data refresh based on current filter criteria.

events.name: @config.on event click
events.description: Emitted when a calendar chip is clicked ({ event } carries the clicked row) or an agenda/upcoming row action fires ({ id, row }). Consumers routing it should read the row from ?event or ?row, whichever the payload carries.

events.name: Select Slot
events.description: A time slot has been chosen for an event.

agendaListBodyContent.label: Agenda list body content tree
agendaListBodyContent.description: Render-ui SExpr for calendarLook='agenda-list' — events grouped by day with overline day headers (Today, Tomorrow, …) and a time marker per event.

agendaItemActions.label: Agenda item actions
agendaItemActions.description: Per-item action buttons on agenda-list rows — data-list itemActions descriptors (label/event/icon/variant). Consumers override to wire their own row actions (View/Edit/Delete) so agenda hosts never need a second table for actions.
agendaItemActions.synonyms: agenda actions, row actions, event actions, list actions

startField.label: Start field
startField.description: Row column holding the timestamp the calendar grid places each chip by. Rebound hosts point this at their own column (e.g. startTime, startsAt, dueAt); the chip's LABEL comes from titleBinding, not from here.
startField.synonyms: start column, date column, when field, timestamp field

filterBarLook.label: Filter bar look
filterBarLook.description: Visual treatment for the embedded filter bar, mirroring std-filter's own enum. Only applies when `filters` is non-empty.
filterBarLook.synonyms: filter bar style, facet style, chips, pills

bodyContent.label: Body content tree
bodyContent.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after events load for calendarLook='month' — the month-grid + upcoming-events list. calendarLook='agenda-list' / 'week-timeline' render agendaListBodyContent / weekTimelineBodyContent instead; all three share this trait's state machine, emits, and listens.

descriptionBinding.label: Description binding
descriptionBinding.description: Per-row binding for the event description slot.

filters.label: Which filters should appear above the calendar?
filters.description: Dropdown filter facets by field, rendered as an embedded filter bar above the calendar body (all three calendarLook trees); each selection fires REFETCH_FILTER on this trait. Empty (the default) = no filter bar, which is the right setting whenever the page already composes std-filter beside this calendar and routes XFilter.FILTER -> REFETCH_FILTER — that is the wired owner and remains the primary path. Use this knob only for a standalone calendar with no page-level filter affordance.
filters.synonyms: filter bar, faceted filters, field filters, dropdowns

tableLook.label: Table look
tableLook.description: Layer 2 visual treatment for the data table rendered by this atom.

agendaGroupBy.label: Agenda group-by field
agendaGroupBy.description: Row field the agenda list groups its day sections by. Rebound hosts point this at their own timestamp column (e.g. startTime, scheduledAt).
agendaGroupBy.synonyms: group field, section field, day field

bodySearch.label: Show the calendar's own search box?
bodySearch.description: Embeds a title search box in the toolbar above the calendar body (all three calendarLook trees). Defaults false: std-calendar has never had a search box, so an untouched consumer's surface is unchanged; the primary path is composing std-search beside this atom and wiring XSearch.SEARCH -> REFETCH_QUERY. Set true only for a standalone calendar with no page-level search affordance.
bodySearch.synonyms: inline search, calendar search, built-in search, show search, duplicate search

timeBinding.label: Time binding
timeBinding.description: Per-row binding for the event time slot.

titleBinding.label: Title binding
titleBinding.description: Per-row binding for the event title slot.

badgeBinding.label: Badge binding
badgeBinding.description: Per-row binding for the event status/badge slot.

searchPlaceholder.label: Search box placeholder text
searchPlaceholder.description: Hint text inside the calendar's search box (e.g. 'Search events…').
searchPlaceholder.synonyms: search hint, placeholder, search box text, search label

title.label: Title
title.description: Header text shown above the calendar body.

weekTimelineBodyContent.label: Week timeline body content tree
weekTimelineBodyContent.description: Render-ui SExpr for calendarLook='week-timeline' — events grouped by weekday in a 7-column timeline window.

calendarLook.label: Calendar look
calendarLook.description: Layer 3 body layout: default month-grid + upcoming-events list ('month'), day-grouped agenda list ('agenda-list'), or 7-column week timeline ('week-timeline').

include.label: Which relation fields to hydrate?
include.description: Entity relation field names to hydrate on fetch (e.g. a `category : Category` field named `category`), so chip bindings can use dot-paths like @item.category.name. Empty = no hydration, the default.
include.synonyms: relation hydration, populate relations, joined fields, hydrate relations

onEventClick.label: On Event Click
onEventClick.description: Event emitted when a calendar chip is clicked: UI:{onEventClick} with { event } carrying the clicked row. Empty means chips are not clickable.
onEventClick.synonyms: open event, event click, select event, chip click
